nominal_scale.kind: nominal art-direction choice, not a newly measured fossil dimension; display scaling separately labeled

budget_intent.policy: 14k triangles and 1,000,000 bytes are ceilings, not targets. Usually aim about 100–500 KB; below this range is fine. Spend more triangles only for visible silhouette/proportion/connection benefit. Do not pad counts or enlarge textures for apparent refinement. Preserve quality if a justified asset exceeds the usual range within the hard caps.

start_gate: Explicit current parent dispatch permits local geometry and maker checks only.
concurrency: Parent-coordinated shared host pool; default one worker x two Blender threads, no per-batch full-host allocation.

geometry_choices.en: Original nominal8m interpretive offset-ground teaching exposure: the same gently shaped ground/channel marker and three comparable physical sediment layers are displaced across one planar scarp. Real high/low ground and cut-face layer relief remain readable in gray, not two detached painted stones. Crop faces and modest weathering are artistic; no actual earthquake, slip measurement, named site, age or stress direction asserted.
geometry_choices.zh: 原创名义8米错移地面教学露面：同一缓起伏地面/浅槽标志及三层可对照实体沉积层跨一处平面阶坎发生错移，灰模真实高差和剖面层理可读，非两块贴色石。裁面与克制风化属美术，不指实际地震滑移测量地点年代应力方向。
